title: Relative Coefficient Comparison
statement: For every map a:$R$ to $R$-prime of arbitrary commutative condensed rings, profinite $G$ and topological $J$, define the relative scalar-comparison datum: the underived invariant-functor isomorphism fixed by the actual invariant inclusions, and the ordinary derived scalar-comparison isomorphism fixed on EVERY complex by the computation-unit equation, commuting with canonical shifts. These data exist without flatness. Define coefficientMap by composing RGamma of a derived coefficient map with this comparison. The actual beta arrows commute with these maps. For two cyclic total models, define their unique coefficient total isomorphism fixed by both biproduct coordinates and the recorded scalar/group-restriction comparison. Lambda commutes with this total comparison and the derived scalar comparison, as an equality of derived arrows. Uses [def-sfb-relative-derived-invariants], [def-sfb-relative-cyclic-total], [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus].
